description: This file defines an interface 'AcknowledgementConfig' providing configuration methods related to acknowledgements in a service, along with an embedded enum 'AcknowledgementConfigValue' that specifies default configuration values and their paths for acknowledgment timeout and size parameters.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for acknowledgements, including timeout durations, lifetime, and max payload size.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig.AcknowledgementConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of configuration keys with default values for acknowledgement timeout, lifetime, and payload size.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the fallback timeout used when correlating acknowledgements via the AcknowledgementForwarderActor.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the fallback lifetime for collecting acknowledgements with ResponseCollectorActor.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the fallback timeout when asking ResponseCollectorActor for its output.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size in bytes for automatically issued acknowledgements.
